audit.why: Seesaw lane: Mel wins 1-2 (no root online), Neeko edges 3 (E-root into double-bloom Q), Mel takes 4-5 with spacing, Neeko wins 6 (Pop Blossom AoE stun), Mel wins first item onward. Content chart matches the packet chart exactly; full chart was blanket 'Skill'.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text credits the disguise to 'Inherent Glamour (W-disguise)' — Inherent Glamour is her PASSIVE; W is Shapesplitter (clone + empowered third hit).
audit.why: Wrong slot attribution; kit file is authoritative.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; the E-whiff window and R-spent window were never quantified. Rebuttal-vs-combo detail (Q seed is a reflectable projectile, E root is the setup to deny) was generic.
audit.why: Kit gives E 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, Q 9-7, R 120/105/90, Mel W 38-26. Her Q seed is flagged projectile — Rebuttal reflects it; her R is a leap+stun, not a projectile.
48.6% over 644 games; EVEN 5.5/10 framing is consistent.
